# E0 — the baseline every later rung is measured against

*Generated by `make_e0_report.py` from `data/derived/`, the output of `amog_train.py` — the same engine the whole ladder runs on. Commit `0b2abe2`, 2026-08-26.*

## Configuration

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| Backbone | resnet50 (24.0M parameters), ImageNet-initialised |
| ROI geometry | 60.0 mm physical FOV |
| Split | frozen, 1381 train / 296 val / 297 test patients |
| Split digest | `4763bf66a52bd467…` |
| Schedule | cosine, 1 warm-up epochs, 12 epochs, no early stopping |
| Selected epoch | 9 (best validation macro-F1 0.6921) |
| Test predictions | 7,310 targets over 297 patients |

## Held-out test result

| Metric | Value |
| :--- | ---: |
| Accuracy | 84.56% |
| Balanced accuracy | 69.14% |
| Macro F1 | 0.6948 |
| **QWK** | **0.7203** |
| ECE (uncalibrated) | 0.1226 |
| ECE (temperature-scaled) | 0.0439 |
| Severe recall | 60.8% |
| Severe graded Normal/Mild | 5.5% |
| Two-grade errors | 0.52% |

### Confusion

| truth \ predicted | Normal/Mild | Moderate | Severe | recall |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **Normal/Mild** | 5,295 | 410 | 16 | 92.6% |
| **Moderate** | 421 | 644 | 126 | 54.1% |
| **Severe** | 22 | 134 | 242 | 60.8% |

Errors are almost entirely between adjacent grades (0.52% span two), which is the behaviour an ordinal target should produce. Severe is 6.3% of the corpus and the grade with the clearest clinical consequence; it is recovered at 60.8% recall, so the score is not an artefact of ignoring the rare class.

### Calibration

Temperature fitted on the validation split after model selection (T = 3.348), then applied unchanged to the test set: ECE **0.1226 → 0.0439**. Both figures are reported, because calibration is not guaranteed to help and reporting only the corrected column would conceal the cases where it does not.

## Negative control: permuted labels

Labels were permuted *within* each partition, leaving the class distribution untouched and destroying only the image-to-label correspondence. A pipeline leaking information — through the split, the cache index or the target table — would still score well here.

| Metric | Real | Control |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| QWK | 0.7203 | **-0.0104** |
| Macro F1 | 0.6948 | 0.3267 |
| Balanced accuracy | 69.14% | 33.47% |
| Severe recall | 60.8% | 0.3% |

The control collapses to chance, as it must. Chance balanced accuracy for three classes is 33.33%. The signal in the real run therefore comes from the images, not from the partitioning.

## What this result is, and is not

- It **is** the reference point for E1–E7. Any later rung claiming a gain must report it against these numbers, on this split, with this control re-run.
- It **is not** a solution to localisation. The crop is centred on the released annotation coordinate, so the model is given the location and asked only to grade it.
- It **is not** comparable to RSNA Kaggle leaderboard scores, which use a different weighted-log-loss metric on a different held-out set.
- Accuracy is the least informative column here. The majority class is 77.3% of the corpus, and a model predicting Normal/Mild for every target scores that accuracy with QWK exactly 0.0000.

## Two defects this baseline exposed

Recorded because they change how any earlier E0 number should be read, and because both were invisible until two independent implementations were compared.

1. **E0 read the wrong sequence for 59.5% of targets.** RSNA annotates canal stenosis on sagittal T2 and subarticular stenosis on axial T2, but the model took the sagittal T1 slot unconditionally. 28,963 of 48,657 targets were graded from a geometry-projected crop of a sequence no radiologist had marked.
2. **Backbones were randomly initialised.** A 24M-parameter ResNet-50 was being trained from scratch on 34k crops.

Together these cost **0.4650 QWK** (0.2553 → 0.7203) and left Severe recall at 8.3% with 78.4% of severe cases graded Normal/Mild.

## Reproducing

```bash
python implementation/05_roi_crops/build_roi_cache.py \
    --rsna_dir <RSNA> --name rsna_roi_v2 --fov_mm 60 --radius 1
python implementation/amog_train.py --stage E0 --mode real --backbone resnet50
python implementation/amog_train.py --stage E0 --mode real --backbone resnet50 --shuffle_labels
python implementation/99_audit/make_e0_report.py
```
